pr.title: fix(pr-steward): align trusted audit not-required runtime and schema
pr.body: L3 CI-trust compatibility repair R1. The first A5 preflight proved two coupled defects: PR Steward blocks every SKIPPED audit, and merge_readiness.schema.json permits READY only for PASS/PASS_WITH_RISKS. R1 fixes both boundaries together. The normalized Steward audit artifact preserves required/skip_reason; runtime and schema permit READY+SKIPPED only for the exact trusted NOT_REQUIRED representation required=false + AUDIT_NOT_REQUIRED_BY_TRUSTED_CHANGE_CONTRACT. Required, malformed, unknown, or differently skipped audits remain fail-closed. WSAC PR #1327 remains parked and unchanged.
